---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new capability
labels: enhancement
---

## What & why

What would you like, and what problem does it solve? If it relates to accuracy, name the
game or test ROM that exposes the gap.

## Which part

- [ ] Emulation accuracy (CPU / PPU / APU / timer / MBC)
- [ ] Desktop frontend
- [ ] Terminal frontend
- [ ] Web (WASM)
- [ ] FFI
- [ ] Tooling / docs / CI

## Notes

Any references (Pan Docs section, test-ROM readme, prior art) or context. Check the
[Roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap--goals) first — some of this may already be planned.
